description: Adapter Compatibility Test Harness - Add contract tests for workflow adapters and provider boundaries so optional integrations remain replaceable and safe.

userStories.title: Define adapter contract test matrix
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a contract test matrix for workflow adapters so that request/response boundaries remain stable across implementations.
acceptanceCriteria: Adapter contract tests cover expected request and response boundaries for supported adapter interfaces
Contract test matrix documents required adapter behaviors and invariants
researchTopics: Existing adapter interface patterns and test conventions in this repository
Best practice patterns for contract tests that validate interchangeable adapters
userStories.notes: Depends on PRD-001 workflow state and contract baseline.

userStories.title: Validate optional provider degradation behavior
userStories.description: As an operator, I want fallback and degradation tests for optional providers so that failures degrade safely without data loss.
acceptanceCriteria: Failure scenarios in optional providers are covered with contract-level tests
Degradation and fallback behavior preserves workflow state without data loss
researchTopics: Current optional provider fallback paths and failure semantics in workflow adapters
State preservation checks needed to verify no data loss during provider failure

userStories.title: Add adapter compatibility signal to CI and release checks
userStories.description: As a release engineer, I want CI and release checks to include adapter compatibility signals so that adapter interface regressions are caught before release.
acceptanceCriteria: CI pipeline includes adapter compatibility test signal
Release check output includes adapter compatibility status
researchTopics: Existing CI and release-check integration points for adding new quality signals
